sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows you to add one or more existing contacts to a group in a single API call. This is the ideal tool for synchronizing your contact list from another system, such as a CRM, an e-commerce platform, or a customer database, ensuring your contacts are always up-to-date.

Before you start using this endpoint, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
Content-TypeStringapplication/json
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization

Example request header:
PUT https://api.spryng.nl/v2/groups/{groupId}/contacts
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
-H 'Content-Type: application/json'

sections.title: Request body
sections.content:
If a required parameter is not provided, or incorrect, the request will fail. If a parameter is conditional, it is only required for certain channels or is dependent on the desired format of the message.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
contactsIdJSON arrayRequiredThe contactIds to be added to the group provided as an array in the body e.g. "68890cd2-7d9d-43c4-8fc9-8de20160e76f"

Request body example
{
    "contactIds": [
        "59152cde-77d2-414b-b616-a3a70c8f2a47" //could be more contacts added here
    ]
}

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
200 OK
Success response.
{
    "data": {
        "groupContacts": [
            {
                "groupContactId": "c92fd77e-9386-429d-a240-a1c3c380c0dd",
                "groupId": "cb960734-8a57-442d-983c-92526456d3ed",
                "contactId": "ad3db3a0-9989-4ebf-b64b-d12c2c2895d0",
                "lastUpdatedBy": "907da4a7-bb93-4772-8af4-a95cc59e5a91",
                "createTimestamp": "2024-11-26T14:56:36.7986345Z"
            }
        ]
    }
}

Error codes
400 Bad Request
The server was unable to process your request due to an invalid or missing required property, i.e. contactId was provided in an invalid format (not GUID).
Response example
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "errorCode",
            "errorMessage": "errorMessage"
        }
    ]
}

404 Not Found
The server was unable to process your request due to an invalud or missing groupId.
Response example
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "group_not_found",
            "errorMessage": "There is no group with the specified Id."
        }
    ]
}

401 Unauthorized
The authorization header is missing or invalid.
Example response
{
    "title": "An error occurred while processing the request",
    "status": 401,
    "message": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/groups/123/contacts' was unauthenticated",
    "errors": {},
    "internalErrors": [
        {
            "message": "Pipeline",
            "metadata": {
                "unauthenticatedError": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/groups/123/contacts' was unauthenticated"
            }
        }
    ]
}
